titleEn: Law on the Amendments of the Law on Political Parties and the Law on the Amendment of Law on Political Parties

articles.en:
New Article 6 (two): every political party shall not carry out any of the following acts:
1- creating division which causes harm to national unity and territorial integrity.
2- carrying out activities against the democratic, liberal and multi-party regime and the constitutional monarchy.
3- affecting the security of the State.
4- establishing armed forces.
5- inciting acts which may lead to national division.
6- using the voice, images or documents in writing of, or acts by, persons convicted of a felony or a misdemeanour, for the political benefit of its own political party.
7- consenting by silence or indifference, or conspiring with persons convicted of a felony or a misdemeanour, to carry out any act for the political benefit of its own political party.
8- supporting, or planning, or conspiring with any individual carrying out activities with the aim of opposing the interests of the Kingdom of Cambodia, as set out in points 1 to 5 above.

New Article 11: every political party shall have a name and a symbol as determined below:
1- The full name, abbreviation and symbol of a political party must be different from the full name or abbreviation and symbol of any other political party.
2- The name of a political party shall not be created merely by slightly modifying the names of existing political parties, or by adopting the name of a natural person.
3- The symbol of a political party shall not copy or adopt the national symbol, images representing religion, the Angkor Wat temple, or the image, portrait or statue of any Khmer king, or images of natural persons.

Article 44 (two): without prejudice to other criminal penalties, a political party that has committed an offence against new Article 6 (two) of this Law and Article 7 of the Law on Political Parties may be dealt with by the court as follows: - suspension of the activities of that political party for not more than 5 (five) years.
- dissolution of that political party.

Article 45 (duplicate): a political party whose activities have been suspended shall not be permitted to participate in electoral competition.
Its name shall be removed from the list of political parties standing for election where that political party has been suspended or dissolved in accordance with this Law.

Article 48: any political party whose name or symbol is the name or image of a natural person shall change its name or symbol in accordance with the provisions of this Law within 90 (ninety) days at the latest from the date of entry into force of this Law.
Article 2. This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, [day illegible] [month illegible] 2017, in the Royal name and by Royal command; Acting Head of State, signature and Royal seal, Samdech Vibol Sena Pheakdei Say Chhum; having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; No. [illegible] S.Ch.; certified true copy for distribution, Phnom Penh, 2017
